links.outcome: Validity of references and citations in LLM-generated prior authorization letters
links.effect: 27 of 29 letters (93.1%) cited valid references; one letter cited an incorrect trial and another cited a correct KDIGO guideline with an inaccessible link.
links.quote: 27 letters (93.1%) cited valid references, with one letter citing an incorrect trial and another one citing a correct KDIGO guideline with inaccessible link.

links.outcome: Correctness of ICD-10 diagnosis coding in LLM-generated letters
links.effect: ICD-10 code correct in 23 of 29 letters (79.3%); errors mostly involved CKD staging or internal diagnostic inconsistencies.
links.quote: The ICD-10 diagnosis code was correct in 23 letters (79.3%), most errors were related to chronic kidney disease (CKD) staging or internal diagnostic inconsistencies.

screen.reason: Evaluated the quality, accuracy, and clinical reasoning of LLM-generated prior authorization letters across 29 nephrology scenarios without comparing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
